# Digital Growth Society

Digital Growth Society (DGS) is a private mastermind of twelve SEO agency owners hosted by Richard Fong of Bliss Drive. The group has met every Friday since 2019 to test ideas in SEO, AI, agency operations and long-term business growth.

## Purpose

DGS gives experienced operators a confidential room to share working playbooks, pressure-test new ideas and help one another solve active business problems. Its operating principle is "Greater together."

## The Distinguished Dozen

- Richard Fong
- Chris Koszo
- Andrew Ansley
- Brian Winum
- Chris Castillo
- Chas Henry
- Chris Labbate
- Cory Hubbell
- Mike Merlino
- Brian Kato
- Brian Hong
- Simon Cornelius

## Speaking to DGS

Experienced SEO and AI practitioners can apply to present to the group. Guest sessions are confidential and normally include a presentation, open discussion and a hot seat focused on one problem the guest wants the room's help solving.

Apply at: https://digitalgrowthsociety.org/#apply

Learn more at: https://digitalgrowthsociety.org/
